name: Woodcock-Johnson Tests of Cognitive Abilities (WJ-IV COG)
description: A comprehensive battery of 18 co-normed tests assessing cognitive abilities across multiple Cattell-Horn-Carroll (CHC) factors including fluid reasoning, comprehension-knowledge, short-term memory, and processing speed.
reputation: Widely used in educational and clinical practice; one of the most theoretically grounded cognitive batteries.
notes: Requires trained examiner; very broad, takes 1–2 hours for full battery.
